Priya Menon: Quick sync 1/03: updating rate & quota docs to cover tiered burst-credit behavior. Need a tiny curl + python SDK snippet showing the X-Redwood-Metering v2 header, and an iframe for the new "Consumption by Tier" panel. Can someone take code + iframe verify?
Alex Chen: Ill do code snippets (curl + python requests). Keep them minimal. Should show fallback to legacy header.
Jordan Lee: Dashboard panel moved. New URL: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-42. iframe: `<iframe src=\"https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-42\" width=\"100%\" height=\"360\"></iframe>`
Samir Patel: wording: change "consumed on submit" -> "applied when the request completes successfully". Add note that timed-out queued requests release reserved credits.
Priya Menon: yes adopt that phrasing. Also add a tiny 3-row example table of events (start, success, timeout) with credits_delta.
Alex Chen: Snippets: `curl -H \"X-Redwood-Metering: {\"client_id\":\"team-17\",\"job_id\":\"j-2026-03\"}\"` and python requests header similarly. Will include one-line note about escaping quotes in shells and fallback `x-metering-legacy`.
Maria Gonzales: I'll localize the new sentence into Spanish: "los créditos de ráfaga se aplican cuando la solicitud finaliza correctamente" and check pluralization for tokens.
Priya Menon: opening a draft PR #3522: docs/metering/snippet-iframe. Assigning Alex (code), Jordan (iframe verify), Samir (behavior copy), Maria (L10n). DocBot: please ping #docs in 48h if no approvals.
DocBot: Reminder scheduled: will post in #docs in 48 hours if PR #3522 has no approvals. :robot_face:
Alex Chen: pushing branch now, will link PR once ready.
